Bug_Title: ICAST: int value cast to float and then passed to Math.round (ICAST_INT_CAST_TO_FLOAT_PASSED_TO_ROUND)
Bug_Details:
This code converts an int value to a float precision
floating point number and then
passing the result to the Math.round() function, which returns the int/long closest
to the argument. This operation should always be a no-op,
since converting an integer to a float should give a number with no fractional part.
It is likely that the operation that generated the value to be passed
to Math.round was intended to be performed using
floating point arithmetic.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded by casting an int value to a float and then passing the result to the Math.round() function, which returns the closest int/long to the argument. This operation should always be a no-op since converting an integer to a float should give a number with no fractional part.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when an int value is cast to float and then passed to Math.round(), which returns the closest int/long to the argument. In the test case, we assert that the result of the showBug method is not equal to the input int value, which will fail if the bug is present.
